subject: [PATCH 2/7] NFSD: cap the number of listeners accepted in listener_set

2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch limits the number of listeners accepted in a single request to NFSD_NL_LISTENER_MAX (1024) to prevent long spin times in atomic context due to nested loops. The existing limit was not capped, allowing for up to ~1M iterations under sv_lock. The new limit is far above any realistic configuration and only rejects requests with an excessively large listener list.
